citation: Classic Chicago Magazine, 'The Mysterious Death of Marshall Field Jr.'. Read 5 November 2026.
author: Classic Chicago Magazine
locator: The account of the shooting at 1919 Prairie and the rumours after it.
rights_note: Cited in words only; nothing copied beyond short quoted fragments.
access_notes: Read 2026-11-05 (T-3378/T-3379) through a fetch that returned the page's sentences in short quoted fragments and paraphrase; this record is cited only for what those fragments say.
note: Fragments read: the shooting on Wednesday 22 November 1905 at 1919 S. Prairie Avenue, his death at Mercy Hospital on Monday 27 November; his reported words, 'I shot myself with that revolver – accidentally'; the coroner's jury's verdict that he 'had shot himself unintentionally while examining a revolver'; the tip to two reporters that he had spent the evening at the Everleigh Club, 2131-33 S. Dearborn, which the sisters denied and nobody confirmed; his parents' house next door at 1905.
what_it_supplies: the date, place and verdict of Field Jr.'s shooting
